confirm.release: Only after favorable DEV, fixed candidate/formula/step, and independent fresh-START repeat candidate + matched control
confirm.source: first C in original holdout manifest order; historically observed shapes; independent frozen new noise

feedback.forbidden: No self-generated pseudo-GT, no detached S/I/E scalar pretending to be differentiable loss, no GT/Gamma to model
feedback.interpretation: Compound real-state and endpoint-GT correspondence intervention; not pure causal state-only ablation
feedback.matched_control: same queued parent/C/Z/t and extra forward/backward; original pre_ot_free to Z OT before HYBRID .25 with independent frozen epsilon; teacher-line FM
feedback.queue: cycle S/I/E by (step-1)%3; sorted UID parent by ((step-1)//3)%8; choose worst of its two noises using S lower / I upper / E global lower; tie lower candidate index
feedback.source: START real Euler50 on frozen TRAIN_FEEDBACK16, all 8 training parents and both noises
feedback.times: 0.6 and 0.8 alternate every complete 24-step queue cycle
feedback.trajectory: free target velocity (GT matched to final generated free slots - real Xt)/(1-t); nested face/corner bijection at final model scale

gates.intervals: Conservative lower/upper; PARTIAL affecting decision -> INCOMPLETE; NA never zero
gates.visual: AI_VISUAL_REVIEW only after real images read; human usability NOT_RUN

stop: No default switch, no extra arms beyond budget, no solver scan, stop after report or wall window; no promotion without evidence

training.optimizer: restored original AdamW step5000 lr1e-5 betas(.9,.95) wd0 clip1
training.precision: FP32 parameters, BF16 forward, FP32 geometry/integration, strict deterministic, SDPA math, TF32 off
training.primary: Original pre-scale free-only OT, HYBRID lambda.25, original logit-normal t, globally normalized free FM
